question.text: A Category III AIF manager at Nachiketa Capital operates a long-short equity strategy using index derivatives. Six months after fund launch, SEBI issues a circular tightening the treatment of leverage for Cat III AIFs, increasing compliance burden. Per NISM Ch 1.4.3, the risk that materialised is BEST classified as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulatory risk is the unpredictability of the investment regulatory framework and the risk that existing regulations become more stringent, increasing transaction costs. A SEBI circular tightening leverage treatment for Cat III AIFs is a direct example. The Trap: Political risk addresses broader political/economic regime shifts; market risk relates to price movements; business risk concerns firm-level income volatility - none captures a SEBI rule change. Note: Source page 23 of FINAL Series XIX-C AIF Managers (Dec 2025) workbook.
